# Protocol diagnostics and exit statuses

| Code | Class | Stable meaning | Retry guidance |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cli_usage` | `source` | The command, option, or argument grammar is invalid. | Correct the request using capabilities output. |
| `data_root_absent` | `source` | A selected first-party data root does not exist. | Initialize the root or restore a strict logical backup into an absent destination. |
| `data_root_type` | `source` | A selected first-party data root is not an ordinary directory. | Select an ordinary local directory that does not traverse symbolic links. |
| `data_path_symlink` | `source` | A data lifecycle path traverses a symbolic link. | Select an ordinary path with no symbolic-link component. |
| `data_path_traversal` | `source` | A data lifecycle path contains a parent-traversal component. | Select a confined path without '..' components. |
| `data_root_inventory` | `corrupt` | A data root is incomplete or contains foreign authoritative entries. | Preserve the root; restore a verified backup into a new absent destination. |
| `data_store_identity_changed` | `corrupt` | The physical data-store identity changed while the root was open. | Stop using the root and restore a verified backup into a new absent destination. |
| `data_head_checksum` | `corrupt` | The accepted data-head envelope fails canonical integrity validation. | Preserve the root; restore a verified backup into a new absent destination. |
| `data_revision_checksum` | `corrupt` | An immutable accepted data revision fails canonical integrity validation. | Preserve the root; restore a verified backup into a new absent destination. |
| `data_backup_checksum` | `corrupt` | A logical data backup fails canonical integrity validation. | Use the complete backup bytes and verify their separately retained digest. |
| `data_restore_destination_exists` | `source` | A data restore destination already exists. | Choose an absent destination; restore never overwrites a root. |
| `data_output_exists` | `source` | A data backup output path already exists. | Choose an absent output path; backup never overwrites a file. |
| `data_limit` | `source` | A deployment-selected data limit is zero or above its executable maximum. | Select independent limits within the deployment and global capability bounds. |
| `data_verify_bytes` | `resource` | Complete data-root verification exceeds its independent byte accounting domain. | Preserve the root and use a verified executable with sufficient admitted resources. |
| `data_head_visibility_unknown` | `infrastructure` | A data-head visibility change failed with an indeterminate publication result. | Reopen and verify the exact root before deciding whether any logical retry is safe. |
| `data_head_durability_unknown` | `infrastructure` | A visible data head could not be confirmed durable at the root boundary. | Reopen and verify the exact root before deciding whether any logical retry is safe. |
| `control_input_bytes` | `resource` | Compact input exceeds its deterministic byte bound. | Reduce the request or move large values to an advertised external input. |
| `control_utf8` | `source` | Compact input is not valid UTF-8. | Encode the request as valid UTF-8 records. |
| `control_record_count` | `source` | Compact input exceeds its record-count format bound. | Split the semantic work into smaller exact-base requests. |
| `control_record_bytes` | `source` | One compact physical record exceeds its byte bound. | Use flat fragments or an advertised external value input. |
| `control_operation` | `source` | A compact record has a malformed or unknown operation token. | Select an operation reported by the focused capabilities section. |
| `control_field_separator` | `source` | Compact fields are not separated by ASCII whitespace. | Separate each field assignment with ASCII whitespace. |
| `control_field_count` | `source` | One compact record exceeds its field-count format bound. | Use additional flat records for repeated or nested facts. |
| `control_field_name` | `source` | A compact field name is malformed. | Use the closed lowercase field name reported by capabilities. |
| `control_duplicate_field` | `source` | One compact record repeats a field name. | Supply each closed field exactly once. |
| `control_field_equals` | `source` | A compact field is missing its immediate equals delimiter. | Write each assignment as field=value. |
| `control_value_missing` | `source` | A compact field has no value. | Supply a bare or quoted explicit value. |
| `control_bare_value` | `source` | A bare compact value contains a byte that requires quoting. | Quote the value using the advertised deterministic escaping rule. |
| `control_quote_unclosed` | `source` | A quoted compact value is not closed on its physical record. | Close the quote on the same record. |
| `control_escape_truncated` | `source` | A quoted compact escape ends before its payload. | Complete the escape sequence. |
| `control_escape_unknown` | `source` | A quoted compact value uses an unknown escape. | Use one escape reported by the compact record grammar. |
| `control_unicode_escape` | `source` | A Unicode compact escape is malformed. | Use a canonical hexadecimal Unicode scalar escape. |
| `control_unicode_scalar` | `source` | A Unicode compact escape does not identify a scalar value. | Use a valid Unicode scalar value. |
| `control_quoted_control` | `source` | A quoted compact value contains an unescaped control character. | Escape control characters using the compact grammar. |
| `control_value_bytes` | `source` | One decoded compact value exceeds its byte bound. | Use an advertised external value input or reduce the value. |
| `change_request_missing` | `source` | A compact change has no request record. | Add exactly one request record with an exact base revision. |
| `change_request_duplicate` | `source` | A compact change has more than one request record. | Retain one request record and one exact base. |
| `change_operations_missing` | `source` | A compact change has no semantic operation. | Add at least one operation reported by capabilities --section change. |
| `change_operation_unknown` | `source` | A compact change record is not registered. | Select a record reported by capabilities --section change. |
| `change_field_unknown` | `source` | A compact semantic record contains an unknown field. | Remove the field or use the focused operation grammar. |
| `change_field_missing` | `source` | A compact semantic record omits a required field. | Supply the exact required field reported by focused discovery. |
| `change_field_value` | `source` | A compact semantic field has an invalid typed value. | Correct the value using the field diagnostic and focused grammar. |
| `change_local_label` | `source` | A request-local symbol or fragment label is malformed. | Use a portable $ semantic label or @ type label. |
| `change_idempotency` | `source` | An idempotency key violates its portable byte contract. | Use 1 through 128 portable identifier bytes. |
| `change_intent_bytes` | `source` | Nonsemantic intent exceeds its byte bound. | Shorten or omit the intent field. |
| `change_boolean` | `source` | A compact boolean is not exactly true or false. | Use true or false. |
| `change_visibility` | `source` | A declaration visibility value is unknown. | Use private, package, or public. |
| `change_port_reference` | `source` | A port reference is neither a request-local symbol nor an exact package/port identity. | Use $symbol or pkg_ID/port_ID as reported by focused change discovery. |
| `change_runner_kind` | `source` | A target runner is outside the public topology slice. | Use command or http as reported by focused change discovery. |
| `change_dependency_binding_unsupported` | `source` | Dependency addition does not name the exact executable-owned built-in binding. | Discover the current built-in package, semantic revision, and package revision and stage its exact exported transport. |
| `change_declaration_selector` | `source` | A declaration selector has no supported exact form. | Use $symbol, decl_ID, or MODULE/NAME. |
| `change_local_reference` | `source` | A local-value reference has a foreign or malformed identity domain. | Use a compatible request symbol, parameter ID, or binding ID. |
| `change_edge_index_duplicate` | `source` | A flat fragment repeats one child index. | Use each zero-based child index once. |
| `change_edge_index_order` | `source` | A flat fragment's child indexes are not contiguous from zero. | Provide the missing index or renumber the fragment edges. |
| `change_edge_parent` | `source` | A flat child edge names no matching parent fragment. | Define the exact expression or type parent label. |
| `change_type_duplicate` | `source` | A compact type label is defined more than once. | Define each @ type label once. |
| `change_type_reference` | `source` | A compact type reference is neither primitive nor an @ label. | Use an advertised primitive or defined @ type label. |
| `change_type_undefined` | `source` | A compact type label is referenced but not defined. | Define the referenced @ type fragment. |
| `change_type_cycle` | `semantic` | Compact type fragments contain an ill-founded cycle. | Use an exact named declaration reference at recursive boundaries. |
| `change_type_form_unknown` | `source` | A compact type fragment uses an unknown form. | Select a form reported by capabilities --section type. |
| `change_expression_duplicate` | `source` | A compact expression label is defined more than once. | Define each $ expression label once. |
| `change_expression_reference` | `source` | An expression reference is not a request-local $ label. | Use a defined $ expression label. |
| `change_expression_undefined` | `source` | An expression label is referenced but not defined. | Define the referenced $ expression fragment. |
| `change_expression_cycle` | `semantic` | Compact expression fragments contain an ownership cycle. | Make expression fragments one acyclic owned tree. |
| `change_expression_unused` | `source` | A compact expression fragment is unreachable from every operation. | Remove the fragment or attach it to one semantic operation. |
| `change_expression_shared` | `source` | A compact expression fragment has more than one owner. | Define a distinct fragment for each owned tree position. |
| `change_expression_form_unknown` | `source` | A compact expression fragment uses an unknown form. | Select a form reported by capabilities --section expression. |
| `change_effect_unsupported` | `source` | The compact operation does not expose the requested function effect. | Use the advertised effect or wait for the complete typed form cutover. |
| `change_precondition_unknown` | `source` | A compact request uses an unknown semantic precondition. | Select a precondition reported by capabilities --section change. |
| `change_precondition_namespace_class` | `source` | A namespace precondition uses an unknown namespace class. | Select a change.namespace-class value from focused change discovery. |
| `change_precondition_owner_missing` | `semantic` | An owner-exists precondition observed no live exact owner. | Refresh the exact owner at the observed base and rebuild the request. |
| `change_precondition_owner_present` | `semantic` | An owner-absent precondition observed a live exact owner. | Refresh the exact owner at the observed base and rebuild the request. |
| `change_precondition_owner_name` | `semantic` | An exact owner no longer has the expected name. | Inspect that owner at the observed base and rebuild the request. |
| `change_precondition_owner_parent` | `semantic` | An exact owner no longer has the expected semantic parent. | Inspect that owner at the observed base and rebuild the request. |
| `change_precondition_namespace_present` | `semantic` | A namespace expected to be free points to a live owner. | Inspect the exact namespace owner and choose another name or base. |
| `change_precondition_namespace_owner` | `semantic` | A namespace no longer points to the expected exact owner. | Refresh the namespace and exact owner at the observed base. |
| `change_precondition_namespace_witness` | `corrupt` | A derived namespace entry disagrees with its canonical owner record. | Preserve the repository and report the exact diagnostic; do not retry a write. |
| `change_precondition_dependency_binding` | `semantic` | A package dependency no longer has the expected semantic and package revisions. | Inspect the exact dependency binding at the observed base and rebuild the request. |
| `change_delete_policy` | `source` | A compact deletion requests an unsupported policy. | Use exactly policy=reject or policy=owned-closure. |
| `change_delete_owned_children` | `semantic` | Reject deletion selected an owner with owned identities. | Delete a leaf owner with reject or review the exact policy=owned-closure plan. |
| `change_delete_live_reference` | `semantic` | A live semantic relation still targets the selected owner. | Repair every exact consumer in the same request or retain the owner. |
| `change_delete_created_owner` | `semantic` | One request creates and deletes the same owner. | Remove both operations instead of publishing an identity-only no-op. |
| `change_delete_duplicate` | `semantic` | One request selects the same owner for deletion more than once. | Retain one exact delete operation. |
| `change_delete_expression_parent` | `semantic` | A binding or expression was selected as an independent deletion root. | Replace its exact owning body or parent semantic field. |
| `change_delete_parent_membership` | `semantic` | A selected member is not attached exactly once to its expected parent. | Refresh exact owner context and re-plan against the observed base. |
| `change_delete_parent_kind` | `semantic` | A selected member is incompatible with its recorded parent kind. | Refresh exact owner context and select the correct semantic parent. |
| `change_delete_owner_cache` | `corrupt` | Deletion preparation lost a selected canonical owner. | Preserve the repository and report the exact diagnostic; do not retry a write. |
| `change_delete_ownership_endpoint` | `corrupt` | An ownership relation has an invalid endpoint domain. | Preserve the repository and report the exact diagnostic; do not retry a write. |
| `change_delete_ownership_missing` | `corrupt` | An accepted owner has no exact ownership witness. | Preserve the repository and report the exact diagnostic; do not retry a write. |
| `change_delete_ownership_disagreement` | `corrupt` | An ownership witness is not reproduced by accepted canonical meaning. | Preserve the repository and report the exact diagnostic; do not retry a write. |
| `change_delete_ownership_package` | `corrupt` | An ownership relation crosses a foreign package boundary. | Preserve the repository and report the exact diagnostic; do not retry a write. |
| `change_delete_relation_disagreement` | `corrupt` | An incoming relation witness is not reproduced by accepted canonical meaning. | Preserve the repository and report the exact diagnostic; do not retry a write. |
| `change_delete_revision` | `corrupt` | Deletion preparation has no exact accepted base revision. | Preserve the repository and report the exact diagnostic; do not retry a write. |
| `change_plan_domain` | `source` | A reviewed plan token has the wrong typed prefix. | Use the exact plan_ token returned by change plan. |
| `change_plan_length` | `source` | A reviewed plan token has the wrong two-component length. | Use the complete 128-hex-character plan_ token returned by change plan. |
| `change_request_commitment_field_length` | `resource` | A normalized request field exceeds its commitment length domain. | Reduce the request within the advertised compact input bounds. |
| `change_plan_hex` | `source` | A reviewed plan token has noncanonical hexadecimal bytes. | Use the lowercase plan_ token returned by change plan. |
| `change_request_commitment_mismatch` | `semantic` | The reviewed request commitment differs from normalized input. | Re-run change plan for the exact input before project discovery. |
| `change_prepared_plan_mismatch` | `semantic` | The reviewed prepared-plan commitment differs from the reprepared logical plan. | Re-run change plan against the current exact base and review the complete logical plan. |
| `change_plan_output_project_path` | `source` | A logical plan output target is at or below normalized project authority. | Choose an explicit review-file path outside the normalized project root. |
| `change_plan_output_type` | `source` | A logical plan output target is a symlink or is not a regular file. | Choose an absent path or an existing ordinary regular file. |
| `change_plan_output_existing_bytes` | `resource` | An existing logical plan output exceeds bounded comparison admission. | Remove the unrelated oversized file or choose another explicit output path. |
| `change_plan_output_byte_budget` | `resource` | A complete logical plan exceeds its independent file-byte admission. | Reduce the semantic change; logical plan output is never truncated. |
| `change_plan_output_record_budget` | `resource` | A complete logical plan exceeds its independent file-record admission. | Reduce the semantic change; logical plan output is never truncated. |
| `change_plan_output_parent` | `infrastructure` | The logical plan output parent cannot be resolved. | Create and authorize the parent directory, then retry planning. |
| `change_plan_output_project` | `infrastructure` | The normalized project root cannot be resolved for output isolation. | Preserve the project and repair its path before retrying. |
| `change_plan_output_metadata` | `infrastructure` | Logical plan output target metadata cannot be inspected safely. | Repair target permissions or choose another path. |
| `change_plan_output_create` | `infrastructure` | A unique private logical plan output stage cannot be created. | Repair parent permissions and retry; accepted authority was not changed. |
| `change_plan_output_write` | `infrastructure` | Canonical logical plan records cannot be written to the private stage. | Repair filesystem capacity or permissions and retry planning. |
| `change_plan_output_sync` | `infrastructure` | The complete private logical plan stage cannot be synchronized. | Repair the filesystem and retry; the target was not published. |
| `change_plan_output_stage_remove` | `infrastructure` | An equal private logical plan stage cannot be removed. | Inspect the reported sibling stage and parent permissions before retrying. |
| `change_plan_output_publish` | `infrastructure` | The synchronized logical plan stage cannot be atomically renamed. | Repair the target filesystem boundary and retry planning. |
| `change_plan_output_parent_sync` | `infrastructure` | The logical plan output parent cannot be synchronized after publication. | Inspect the complete target file and filesystem durability before retrying. |
| `change_plan_output_compare_metadata` | `infrastructure` | Logical plan stage or target metadata changed during bounded comparison. | Remove the external race and retry planning. |
| `change_plan_output_compare_open` | `infrastructure` | A logical plan stage or target cannot be opened for bounded comparison. | Repair target permissions and retry planning. |
| `change_plan_output_compare_read` | `infrastructure` | A logical plan stage or target cannot be read during bounded comparison. | Repair the filesystem and retry planning. |

| `change_plan_file_read` | `source` | A logical plan file stream cannot be read completely. | Supply a readable complete canonical plan file. |

| `kernel_full_target_port_owner` | `semantic` | A target selects a port that is not owned by its exact component. | Select a port added to the target component or correct the component reference. |
| `kernel_type_target_http_runner` | `semantic` | An HTTP target port does not have the exact semantic HTTP function shape. | Use the discovered structural HTTP request/response function type and implementation. |
| `kernel_type_target_command_runner` | `semantic` | A command target selects the semantic HTTP port shape. | Use runner=http or select a pure command-shaped port. |
| `kernel_type_task_requirement` | `semantic` | A task function requires a capability absent from its component closure. | Add a matching component requirement with every operation used by the function. |
| `kernel_affine_resource_parameter_use` | `semantic` | A direct capability-resource operation parameter is not explicitly borrowed or consumed. | Set use=borrow for observation or use=consume for an ownership-ending transition. |
| `kernel_affine_nonresource_parameter_use` | `semantic` | A nonresource parameter declares affine borrow or consume behavior. | Use unrestricted for ordinary values or change the parameter to one direct capability-resource type. |
| `kernel_affine_resource_container` | `semantic` | A capability resource appears in a forbidden record, collection, stream, result, option, or function container. | Keep it direct or in one nominal variant case. |
| `kernel_affine_function_parameter` | `semantic` | A function parameter contains a capability resource. | Keep resources task-local; resource transfer across function boundaries is not supported. |
| `kernel_affine_function_result` | `semantic` | A function result contains a capability resource. | Consume or drop the resource within its acquiring task instead of returning it. |
| `kernel_affine_record_field` | `semantic` | A record field contains a capability resource. | Keep the resource direct or place it in the single live case of a nominal variant. |
| `kernel_affine_variant_payload` | `semantic` | A nominal variant resource payload is indirect or otherwise malformed. | Use at most one case whose payload is the direct exact-interface capability-resource type. |
| `kernel_affine_resource_fabricated` | `semantic` | A resource use does not name a live owner acquired from an exact requirement call. | Use the lexical binding produced by the acquiring capability operation. |
| `kernel_affine_resource_copy` | `semantic` | A live capability-resource binding is used as an ordinary copyable value. | Pass it only to an explicit borrow or consume parameter, or transfer it through the supported variant match. |
| `kernel_affine_use_after_consume` | `semantic` | A capability-resource binding is used after an earlier consume transition. | Remove the later use or bind the fresh resource returned by a renewing operation. |
| `kernel_affine_foreign_requirement` | `semantic` | A resource is used through a requirement different from the exact requirement that acquired it. | Use the acquiring requirement for every borrow and consume transition. |
| `kernel_affine_foreign_authority` | `semantic` | A resource argument disagrees with the exact operation requirement or interface. | Use a resource acquired from the same exact requirement and interface. |
| `kernel_affine_branch_join` | `semantic` | Reachable branches do not preserve identical live ownership and provenance. | Consume the resource on every branch or preserve the same owner on every branch. |
| `normalized_resource_limit` | `resource` | A task cannot reserve another live runtime resource before an external effect. | Reduce concurrent live handles or raise the deployment-owned task resource limit where supported. |
| `normalized_resource_foreign_scope` | `capability` | A runtime resource handle belongs to another task scope. | Use only handles acquired by the current task invocation. |
| `normalized_resource_kind` | `capability` | A runtime resource handle has the wrong closed resource kind. | Preserve the exact typed handle produced by the acquiring operation. |
| `normalized_resource_authority` | `capability` | A runtime resource handle belongs to another exact capability requirement. | Route the handle through the requirement that acquired it. |
| `normalized_resource_interface` | `capability` | A runtime resource handle belongs to another exact capability interface. | Preserve the exact interface-bound handle produced by acquisition. |
| `normalized_resource_closed` | `capability` | A runtime resource handle is absent, uncommitted, or already consumed. | Do not retry the closed local right; reacquire through a new capability operation when appropriate. |
| `normalized_resource_reservation_lost` | `infrastructure` | A pre-effect queue-lease reservation disappeared before successor authority installation. | Preserve the candidate and runtime evidence and use a verified executable. |
| `normalized_queue_signature` | `capability` | A durable-queue artifact operation does not have the exact current resource signature. | Rebuild from the current standard package and reject predecessor queue interfaces. |

| Exit | Meaning |
|---:|---|
| 0 | successful or domain-classified nonfailure response |
| 2 | usage, source, semantic, precondition, or conflict failure |
| 3 | capability or cancellation failure |
| 4 | resource exhaustion |
| 5 | corrupt authority or derived state |
| 6 | host infrastructure failure |
| 7 | stale accepted base |
| 8 | invalid candidate meaning |
